EventOurMission1.desc1: Our mission is to turn your ideas into extraordinary experiences that connect people, celebrate moments, and create memories that last a lifetime.
EventOurMission1.desc2: We combine creativity, precision, and passion to deliver seamless events that reflect your vision and exceed your expectations—every single time.

EventOurVision1.subtitle: OUR VISION
EventOurVision1.desc1: Our vision is to be India's most trusted event partner—recognized for creativity, innovation, and flawless execution.
EventOurVision1.desc2: We aspire to set new benchmarks in the event industry by creating extraordinary experiences that inspire, connect, and bring people together, today and for generations to come.

EventOurStory1.subtitle: OUR STORY
EventOurStory1.desc1: Discover the story of EventBazaar.com, India's first comprehensive event planning platform, bridging the gap between ideas and trusted vendors effortlessly.
EventOurStory1.desc2: Welcome to EventBazaar.com - India's first comprehensive event industry platform. It helps you bridge the gap between your ideas and the finest and most trusted vendors in the market.
EventOurStory1.desc3: Our mission is to connect clients with a diverse range of trusted vendors. From Event planners, caterers, decorators, photographers to many niche services like event entertainers, Designers, Stylist, Exhibition services, intelligent lights and many more - our platform ensures that every aspect of your event is covered.
EventOurStory1.desc4: Whether you're planning a grand wedding, an intimate gathering, a corporate seminar, or a religious event, EventBazaar.com makes event planning effortless, efficient, and enjoyable.

EventBlogDetail1.title: Top 10 Wedding Trends to Watch in 2024
EventBlogDetail1.contentIntro: Weddings are constantly evolving, and 2024 is bringing fresh ideas, creative concepts, and personalized touches to make every celebration unique and unforgettable. Whether you're planning an intimate gathering or a grand affair, these top wedding trends will inspire you to create memories that last a lifetime.

sections.title: 1. Intimate & Micro Weddings
sections.desc: More couples are choosing intimate celebrations with their closest family and friends. These smaller weddings focus on meaningful moments, personalized details, and unforgettable experiences.

sections.title: 2. Sustainable Weddings
sections.desc: Eco-conscious weddings are here to stay! From sustainable decor and digital invitations to locally sourced catering, couples are making environmentally friendly choices without compromising on style.

sections.title: 3. Bold & Bright Color Palettes
sections.desc: Say goodbye to pastels! 2024 is all about vibrant hues, contrasting color combinations, and statement decor that bring energy and personality to every celebration.

list.title: Event Manager
list.desc: Lead end-to-end event planning and execution to deliver seamless and impactful experiences.
list.aboutRole: We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Event Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing events that create lasting impressions and exceptional experiences.
responsibilities: Plan, organize, and manage events from concept to completion.
Coordinate with clients to understand requirements and deliver tailored solutions.
Manage budgets, timelines, and resources to ensure smooth execution.
Liaise with vendors, venues, and partners to ensure quality services.
Lead and manage on-site event operations and troubleshoot issues.
Evaluate event success and provide post-event reports.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Hospitality, or related field.
3-5 years of experience in event planning and management.
Strong organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.
Proficiency in event management tools and MS Office.
Creative mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences.
niceToHave: Experience managing large-scale or corporate events.
Knowledge of the latest event trends and technologies.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.desc: At Eventora, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.

policies.title: Cancellation Policy

policies.title: Refund Policy

policies.title: Payment Policy

policies.title: Return Policy

CookiePolicy.description: At Eventora, we use cookies to ensure you get the best experience on our website, maintaining transparency and trust.

policies.title: What are Cookies?
policies.desc: Cookies are small text files placed on your device to collect standard internet log information and visitor behavior information.

policies.title: How We Use Cookies
policies.desc: We use cookies in a range of ways to improve your experience on our website, including understanding how you use our site and keeping you signed in.

policies.title: Types of Cookies We Use
policies.desc: There are a number of different types of cookies, however, our website uses: Functionality, Advertising, and Analytics cookies.

policies.title: How to Manage Cookies
policies.desc: You can set your browser not to accept cookies, but this may cause some of our website features not to function properly.

RefundPolicy.description: At Eventora, we aim for maximum fairness and flexibility when handling refunds and cancellations for our events.

policies.title: General Cancellation
policies.desc: You may cancel your event registration up to 30 days before the event date for a full refund, minus a small processing fee.

policies.title: Late Cancellations
policies.desc: Cancellations made within 30 days of the event are non-refundable but can be transferred to another attendee.

policies.title: Event Rescheduling
policies.desc: If Eventora reschedules an event, your ticket will automatically be transferred to the new date, or you may request a full refund.

policies.title: Refund Process
policies.desc: Approved refunds will be processed and credited back to the original method of payment within 7-10 business days.

EventFaq1.subtitle: FAQS
EventFaq1.description: Find answers to common questions about our events, bookings, services, and everything Eventora.

faqs.question: What is Eventora?
faqs.answer: Eventora is a full-service event management company that specializes in planning and executing corporate events, weddings, social gatherings, and more. We take care of every detail to make your event seamless and memorable.

faqs.question: What types of events does Eventora organize?
faqs.answer: We organize a wide range of events including weddings, corporate events, birthday parties, social gatherings, exhibitions, trade shows, and conferences.

faqs.question: How do I book an event with Eventora?
faqs.answer: You can book an event by contacting us through our website's contact form, giving us a call, or sending us an email. Our team will get back to you to discuss your requirements.

faqs.question: Can you help with destination events?
faqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in planning and executing destination events. Whether it's a destination wedding or a corporate retreat, we handle all the logistics.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book my event?
faqs.answer: We recommend booking as early as possible to ensure availability, especially for large events like weddings or major corporate conferences. Typically, 3 to 6 months in advance is ideal.

faqs.question: Do you offer customized event packages?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our event packages can be customized to suit your specific needs, preferences, and budget.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Our cancellation policy varies depending on the type of event and how close it is to the event date. Please refer to our Refund & Cancellation Policy page for detailed information.

faqs.question: How do I make a payment for my event?
faqs.answer: We accept various forms of payment including bank transfers, credit/debit cards, and online payment gateways. Payment schedules will be discussed during the booking process.

faqs.question: Do you provide on-site support during the event?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our team provides comprehensive on-site support to ensure everything runs smoothly from start to finish.
